Review pass 1 (goal: check scope + ground each of the four proposals in the frozen evidence before placing it).
Read: the four proposals (OCCURV-FIELD-RQ, RSPC-RQ, parentcurv-rq-2026, OCCURVE-RQ) and the shared evidence bundle (E1-E13 identical across bundles f40daafe/1e3482d1/ba8fb09c/8a7a312e).
Observed / where the evidence is:
- E6 (beam survival, 57,439 test rows): baseline context arms l1_br 0.04671, l1_br_euclid 0.06207, l1_only 0.06233, resample 0.06363; gold prefix alive at depth 4 only 0.068-0.088 in every arm. Level-1-only arms nearly match full-depth arms, so level 1 is the dominant recall lever and depth-4 target survival is the binding ceiling.
- E7 (teacher-forced NLL): l1_br has T1 0.00 (level-1 trivially predictable) yet the WORST recall 0.0467; resample has T1 4.55 and the best recall 0.06363. Prefix predictability diagnostics do not track recall.
- E8 (first-level capacity): share of canonical pairs sharing a cluster K=16 0.3106, K=32 0.2164, K=64 0.1547, K=256 0.0822 -> coarser level-1 cells keep behavioural neighbours together; K=256 level 1 is capacity-limited.
- E5 (successor entropy stratification): top-1 mass 0.4375 -> 0.0543 across quintiles, Spearman -0.973, so successor entropy/branchiness is a real, non-degenerate training-only signal.
- E10 (transition graph): 115,582 distinct edges, mean out-degree 5.45 -> per-item/per-code transition statistics are well populated.
Reasoning (scope): all four name a training-only behaviour signal, an explicit curved operation inside the RQ quantiser, a single pathway (behaviour statistic -> curved assignment), the three switches, and a minimal spec; none is a behaviour suffix on an unchanged Euclidean quantiser. So all four are in scope and must be ranked, not struck.
Still open: which placement order, and which single-run risks are disqualifying in practice.

Review pass 2, FINAL (goal: place all four proposals 1..4, each grounded in the bundle; the complete answer is in this record).
Decisive evidence used: E6 (level-1-only 0.0623 and resample 0.0636 already reach the target band; depth-4 gold-prefix survival only 0.068-0.088, so deep spread must lift it above ~0.088 to clear 0.065); E7 (high prefix predictability, l1_br T1=0.00, coexists with the worst recall 0.0467; geodesic/curved recursive arms successor_geodesic_coarse 0.055 and tangent_successor_residual 0.055 did not beat Euclidean l1_br_euclid 0.062); E8 (K=16 0.3106 vs K=256 0.0822 shared-cluster rate -> large coarse level-1 cells help behavioural neighbours, so mechanisms that shrink busy level-1 cells endanger the main recall lever); E5 (entropy/branchiness strongly stratified, Spearman -0.973, so per-code branchiness is a usable behaviour signal); E10 (115,582 edges, out-degree 5.45 -> per-occupant transition statistics are dense enough to measure); E4/E3 (train-only, no leakage).
Placement reasoning: OCCURV-FIELD-RQ first - its per-(level,codeword) curvature is occupancy-normalised (behavioural reach PER OCCUPANT divided by level mean), which is exactly the inverse of the GEOCAP popularity-sized cell that produced l3_collision 0.549 > 0.35, all its bounds are derived (kappa_max=1.754 from c*=0.9, kappa in [0.645,1.754], log-clipped rho) with no tuned constant, decode is log_0 of the same curved codeword so the chart is consistent, and cost is near-free (no extra forward pass). parentcurv-rq-2026 second - the most targeted deep-level fix (curvature from that parent's residual energy, branching entropy, occupancy; level-1 curvature fixed at exactly 1 removes a free constant) and branchiness is backed by E5, but it keeps no level-1 capacity mechanism, and E6 shows the level-1 GEOCAP gain is the main recall lever, plus its curved assignment positions differ from its Euclidean reconstruction r_q=E_l[k], so chart and decode disagree. OCCURVE-RQ third - homeostatic inverse-occupancy radii is rate-distortion-correct and opposes GEOCAP's wrong sign, with behaviour weight grounded in E5, but at level 1 it shrinks the busy cells whose coarseness E8 shows keeps behavioural neighbours together, and the trainable c_l has no geometric-off arm and can drift to its 1e-3 Euclidean clamp, making the geometry decorative in the one run that decides. RSPC-RQ fourth - row-normalised per-pair prior is theoretically demand-neutral, but 1/lnK is unverifiable in one run (its own risk list concedes it may reduce to a pure curved quantiser), the level-1 dummy-row prior is a global successor tilt that can reintroduce GEOCAP's demand bias at the level E6 shows matters most, and E6/E7 show curved/geodesic recursive variants sitting at 0.055 with no capacity shaping; soft-STE temperature EMA plus an extra no-grad epoch forward add single-run variance.

its l=1 dummy-row prior is a global successor tilt that can restore GEOCAP's demand bias at the level E6 shows matters most, there is no per-code capacity shaping, and E6/E7 show curved/geodesic recursive arms stalled at 0.055 (successor_geodesic_coarse, tangent_successor_residual) while Euclidean l1_br_euclid reached 0.062, with softmax temperature EMA and an extra no-grad epoch forward adding single-run variance."}],"objection":"E6 caps the upside of any of these: gold prefix alive at depth 4 is only 0.068-0.088 across all arms while l1_only already reaches 0.0623 and resample 0.0636, so >0.065 requires the deep-level spread to push depth-4 survival above ~0.088, which no measured arm has done; and because the curvature field is detached and only re-tilts assignment, a run that keeps the GEOCAP level-1 numbers and merely spreads level 3 cannot, in one arm with no ablation and no seed repetition, separate the coupling gain from seed noise - the verdict then rests on the recorded diagnostics, which E7 shows (l1_br T1 NLL 0.00 with the worst recall 0.0467) do not track test_recall@10."}
Still open: nothing further from this reviewer; the ranking above is final.
